fields.name: questions[].levels
fields.description: score 题的有序档位，从低到高排列；档位下标从 0 开始，即答案 score 的取值刻度
fields.constraint: score 题 required；2–10 档（spec QuestionParamScore.levels minItems=2 / maxItems=10）

official.quote: A `score` question evaluates an input against ordered `levels`. Define the criteria for each level and arrange them from lowest to highest.

fields.name: questions[].levels[].label
fields.description: 档位名称，答案 probabilities 中按同名 label 回显
fields.constraint: 档位内 required（ScoreLevelParam.required = [label]）；≤1048576 字符

official.quote: "label":{"type":"string","minLength":0,"maxLength":1048576}

fields.name: questions[].levels[].description
fields.description: 可选的档位判定标准说明
fields.constraint: optional；≤1048576 字符

official.quote: "description":{"type":"string","minLength":0,"maxLength":1048576}

fields.name: answers[].score
fields.description: score 答案：各档位下标按概率加权的平均值，可落在两档之间
fields.constraint: score 答案 required；取值落在 [0, 档位数−1]

official.quote: The returned `score` is a probability-weighted average, so it can fall between levels.

fields.name: answers[].probabilities
fields.description: 概率分布：choice 答案为每个候选项一条 {value, probability}；score 答案为每个档位一条 {value（档位下标，从 0 起）, label, probability}
fields.constraint: choice / score 答案 required；≤2000 项（spec）

official.quote: Both `choice` and `score` return probabilities over discrete options.

fields.name: answers[].probabilities[].value
fields.description: 分布项的取值：choice 答案里是候选项取值（string | boolean，与请求同类型）；score 答案里是档位下标（integer，从 0 起）
fields.constraint: 两个分支均 required（ChoiceProbabilityResource.required = [value, probability]；ScoreProbabilityResource.required = [value, label, probability]）

official.quote: "value":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ChoiceValueResource"}｜"value":{"type":"integer","format":"int64"}

fields.name: answers[].probabilities[].label
fields.description: score 答案分布项的档位名称，回显请求 levels[].label；choice 答案无此字段
fields.constraint: score 分支 required（ScoreProbabilityResource.required）

official.quote: "label":{"type":"string","minLength":0}

fields.name: answers[].probabilities[].probability
fields.description: 该取值（候选项或档位）的概率
fields.constraint: 两个分支均 required

official.quote: "probability":{"type":"number"}

fields.name: answers[].confidence
fields.description: choice / score 答案附带的独立置信度，与概率分布分开给出
fields.constraint: choice / score 答案 required

official.quote: Choice and score answers return a probability distribution and a separate `confidence` field.
